comment: Shakeroid v1 reveal pool — 30 text items, one voice/mood family (quiet human moments). Phase 4 adds generated SVG visuals on top (30% of draws, energy-seeded); text pool expanded so text-only streaks still feel varied.
items: A friend texted at 2am just to say they survived the day
Someone left a window open all night, just to hear the rain
A stranger held the elevator door and hummed into the silence
An old letter, tucked inside a library book, dated forty years ago
A child waving at you from the backseat of another car
Someone photographed your empty seat while you were getting coffee
The smell of rain arriving before the storm does
A voicemail you keep but never listen to
Someone dancing alone in the kitchen, convinced nobody is watching
The last page of a used notebook, written with a dying pen
A plant on the windowsill of a house that looks empty
Two people sharing one umbrella, walking in silence
Your name, written in the margin of a stranger's shopping receipt
A bench with a small plaque: for sitting, for thinking
A snowflake melting on a coat sleeve before it can be shown to anyone
Someone's playlist drifting out of an open car window, then gone
A birthday candle relit, just for one more wish
The hour when shops close and streets belong to the streetlights
A note on a door: gone for water — back in five
The last sun on the wall of the tallest building, before the street goes blue
A bicycle left by the flowerbed, basket still holding last week's daisies
A receipt stub for two coffees, found in a coat pocket of a coat you never wore
A dog waiting at the same window at the same hour, certain someone returns
Chalk letters on a pavement, half washed away by last night's rain
The smell of coffee climbing the stairwell, belonging to no one you know
A streetlamp left on all day, unnoticed
The last two words of a conversation overheard through a closing door
A jar of shells on a shelf, carried far from any sea
Train windows flickering past lit kitchens, each one a stranger's evening
A hat on a hook, shaped by years of one head
